clusters.name: Your grandfather Amos's death, 1989–1990
clusters.reason: Around your grandfather Amos's death in July 1989, within the months after: your mother's anxiety rose over money in March 1988 and she stopped talking with your father about it by May 1988; your brother's grades fell in November 1989; your mother's anxiety came down once she returned to work in March 1990. The shifts in your mother's anxiety and your brother's functioning pile up across this period, with your grandfather's death in the middle of them.
